probe_detail.name: Number of words in the caption
Contains a proper noun or brand name
Register of the words clashes with the situation drawn
Withholds the explanation the drawing seems to demand

final.name: Live-news political reference (news-cycle fingerprint)
final.audit_justification: This is an explicit news-cycle fingerprint that only registers whether a political frame is present and load-bearing, not whether the caption is good.
final.upstream_parent: the news cycle live in the week the contest ran, and the entrant's news consumption

final.name: Obvious first-thought pun
final.audit_justification: Reliance on the single most obvious pun is a substantive judgment about the joke's originality and construction, not a fingerprint of production circumstance.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction measures the caption's reliance on a cartoon-specific joke construction, which is evidence about originality and craft. It is not merely a fingerprint of the entry's production circumstances.

final.name: House-style colloquialism
final.audit_justification: Plain conversational register reads as a house/community style marker, though the same plainness can underlie genuinely effective deadpan delivery.

final.name: Topical news and era reference
final.audit_justification: This scores only whether wording dates the entry to a news cycle, a topical/temporal fingerprint unrelated to caption merit.
final.upstream_parent: the news cycle at the moment of the contest

final.name: Meta-humor about the joke/genre itself
final.audit_justification: Meta-humor about the joke genre is a comedic device that is substantively part of the caption's quality, not a formatting or provenance marker.

final.name: Social-norm inversion
final.audit_justification: Whether a social norm supplies the mechanism for the cartoon's absurdity is a judgment about the joke's substantive construction.

final.name: Transcription and typography conventions of the compiled list
final.audit_justification: Explicit typography fingerprint counting punctuation/capitalization conventions, with no plausible link to caption quality.
final.upstream_parent: the transcription and compilation pipeline that produced the entry list, plus the submitter's own typing habits

final.name: Metaphorical or Satirical Mapping
final.audit_justification: Whether the caption maps visual absurdity onto a real-world concept is a judgment about the substance of the joke.

final.name: Generic well-formed complete-sentence 'caption-shaped' joke
final.audit_justification: This explicitly measures generic, cartoon-independent 'caption-shapedness' rather than fit to this specific cartoon, though baseline writing competence may also correlate with genuinely better entries.

final.name: Salient-detail integration
final.audit_justification: Integrating multiple specific visual details into one joke is directly about how well the caption fits this particular cartoon.

final.name: Uniform lowercase/no terminal punctuation transcription style
final.audit_justification: Pure orthographic/transcription habit (lowercase, no terminal punctuation) with no plausible route to genuine caption quality.
final.upstream_parent: transcription/typography convention applied by whoever compiled the entry list

final.name: Phonetic pun precision
final.audit_justification: Precision of a phonetic pun is a substantive craft judgment about the joke's construction.

final.name: Adapted familiar phrase
final.audit_justification: How well a familiar phrase is adapted to fit the scene is a substantive judgment of joke craft.

final.name: Two-reading semantic fit
final.audit_justification: Supporting two simultaneous readings that both fit the cartoon is a substantive joke-construction property.

final.name: Off-screen narrative
final.audit_justification: Implying an off-screen narrative that recontextualizes the moment is a substantive comedic device.

final.name: Terse fragment/staccato delivery
final.audit_justification: Scores staccato/fragment delivery independent of whether it is funny or good, a stylistic/verbosity marker, though it may stem from the same comic-economy skill that produces genuinely better entries.
final.upstream_parent: author's practice in the format (practiced entrant's clipped delivery rhythm)

final.name: Macabre or Edgy Subtext
final.audit_justification: Confidently extracting a dark implication from a mundane visual is a comedic-craft judgment about the caption's content, not a topic tally.

final.name: Dark or transgressive content delivered deadpan
final.audit_justification: Deadpan handling of transgressive content is an explicit comedic-delivery technique, substantive to caption quality.

final.name: Comic economy: punch lands with minimal, load-bearing words
final.audit_justification: Tight compression 'achieving comedic effect' is explicitly tied to how good the caption's punch is, not a mere length tally.

final.name: Novel interpretive angle
final.audit_justification: Finding a surprising but defensible angle over the obvious one is a direct originality judgment about joke substance.

final.name: Datable era idiom fixing the entry to a period
final.audit_justification: Explicit era-idiom fingerprint that dates the entry to a period, independent of whether the reference is well used.
final.upstream_parent: position of the contest in the multi-year series (its era of conventions and shared references)

final.name: Canonical first-thought angle
final.audit_justification: Extent of reliance on the most conventional interpretation is a substantive originality judgment about the joke, even though it scores toward predictability.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction measures use of a conventional interpretation of the specific cartoon, a substantive feature of the caption's originality and construction. Its accessibility does not make it an upstream production nuisance.

final.name: Conversational Deadpan Delivery
final.audit_justification: Mimicking mundane deadpan speech against surreal chaos is a comedic-delivery technique central to the joke's substance.

final.name: Idiom-to-Visual Binding
final.audit_justification: How perfectly an idiom is rendered literal by the drawing's content is a substantive craft judgment about fit to this cartoon.

final.name: Punchline Unpredictability
final.audit_justification: How surprising yet sensible the punchline is given the setup is a direct originality/craft judgment.
